description.value: High Mountain Brewing Co. — widely known as The Brewhouse — has been a Whistler Village anchor since 1997, brewing award-winning ales and lagers on-site and serving a full scratch kitchen of barbecue, pastas, and flatbreads. Part of the Mark James Group, it occupies a large multi-room space with a two-sided fireplace and a generous patio beside the Olympic Rings, making it a natural gathering spot after a day on the bike or the slopes. It is open year-round and capable of handling large groups across its restaurant, bar, and mezzanine levels.
